name: anhedral
description: Build and ship applications with a Cloudflare-first stack, explicit architecture and verified delivery evidence.

interface.longDescription: Six focused skills: Anhedral Init, Dev, Design, Auth, Billing and Hosting. Start with a minimal Expo app and add Hono, identity, data and services as needed, or select the full-product preset. Next.js on Vercel and Vinext on Cloudflare are explicit alternatives. Source, provider accounts and verification stay under your control.
defaultPrompt: Create a new project using [@Anhedral](plugin://anhedral@anhedral). Start by explaining the stack and asking me what it should be about.
